title: DIPAM Participates in Special Campaign 6 for Institutionalising Swachhata and Minimising Pendency
subtitle:
E-waste scrapped through MSTC Limited for Rs. 2,01,777/-
Focus on VIP references, Inter-Ministerial and PMO references and Parliamentary Assurances
body_text: The Department of Investment and Public Asset Management (DIPAM), Ministry of Finance, actively participated in Special Campaign 6 for institutionalising Swachhata and minimising pendency in Government offices during the period from 2nd October, 2026 to 31st October, 2026. DIPAM has no attached or subordinate offices or Autonomous Bodies under it. In the Preparatory Phase from 15th to 30th September, 2026, DIPAM set targets across key areas, focusing on the timely disposal of pending matters such as VIP references, Inter-Ministerial and PMO references and Parliamentary Assurances. Emphasis was placed on simplification of procedures, effective record management through review and weeding of files, and office upkeep activities including cleanliness, space management and disposal of scrap. Subsequently, during the Implementation Phase of the Campaign held from 2nd October, 2026 to 31st October, 2026, DIPAM undertook focused efforts to dispose of the identified targets. The status of disposal across various categories, along with the activities undertaken, is outlined below: Out of the targeted 3 VIP references, all 3 were disposed of. Out of the targeted 8 Parliamentary Assurances, Implementation Reports in respect of 1 have been forwarded to the Lok Sabha Secretariat/Rajya Sabha Secretariat for consideration. Two Cleanliness Campaigns were conducted. The scrapping of e-waste has also been completed through MSTC Limited for an amount of Rs. 2,01,777/-. Senior officials conducted inspections of the office and building premises to assess the preparations and progress of the Campaign, while underscoring the importance of upholding the highest standards of cleanliness. **** KT/AD
